content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe fail to provide reliable payment solutions, deploying your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-step-step|COREMERCH guide to digital]] store can feel impossible. Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela face barriers that restrict digital commerce. However, with COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can build a fully operational digital store using Cloudflare Pages, free from the limitations of conventional payment processors. This guide will take you step-by-step through deploying your digital store without relying on outdated systems. Prepare to unlock the potential of your digital products with sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal-which-architecture-actually-5|Selling Ebooks]]-digital-art-without-paypal-5|architecture]].
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often lock out creators from specific regions, leaving them without options. COREMERCH addresses this by providing a robust stack that leverages free hosting through Cloudflare Pages, secure payment processing via NOWPayments, and ownership of your data. This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators who need a reliable solution that does not depend on third-party platforms. By using this architecture, you gain control over your transactions, ensuring that you can operate independently and efficiently in any market.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before setting up your digital store, ensure you have all necessary components ready. You will need a Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing, and a Google account for managing Apps Script. Gather your digital products, such as ebooks or courses, and prepare the content you plan to sell. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint to understand the deployment process. Additionally, consider your marketing strategy, as it will be essential once your store is live. This preparation will streamline your deployment and help you launch efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your accounts ready, start by setting up your Cloudflare Pages site. Follow the instructions in the Sovereign Blueprint to deploy your site using GitHub and Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept multiple cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Once the payment gateway is configured, set up your automated delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure file storage. This setup guarantees quick and reliable product delivery, enhancing the customer experience. Test the entire pipeline to ensure everything functions seamlessly before moving on.
Leverage Cloudflare's infrastructure for fast and reliable hosting.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is fully configured and tested, it's time to go live. Announce your launch through social media and other channels to attract your audience. After your store is up, simulate transactions using test cryptocurrencies to verify that payments are processed correctly. Encourage early buyers to provide feedback on the purchase experience. Monitoring these first transactions will help you identify any potential issues and improve your infrastructure. With your store operational, focus on optimizing your offerings based on customer feedback and sales data.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As sales grow, consider how to scale your infrastructure to meet demand. You can add more products to your store by following the same setup process for each new item. Utilize Supabase for managing customer data and analytics, which can help you make informed decisions about inventory and marketing. Explore additional marketing strategies to reach wider audiences, leveraging social media and email campaigns to drive traffic. By continuously optimizing your infrastructure and scaling your offerings, you'll position your store for long-term success in the digital marketplace.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Maintain full ownership of your data and transaction history.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Stack 01 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a digital store infrastructure built on GitHub Pages and Apps Script, designed for quick deployment within 4-6 hours. It uses NOWPayments for crypto transactions and offers creators full ownership of their data.
How does Stack 02 differ from Stack 01?

Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a more robust setup, deployed by COREMERCH within 48 hours. It includes additional features like end-to-end testing, enhanced security configurations, and support for up to five products.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on GitHub Pages using Stack 01. It provides a free hosting solution along with the necessary infrastructure to manage payments and product deliveries.
How do I test my payment processing setup?

To test your payment processing, simulate transactions using the test features provided by NOWPayments. Verify that your payment notifications and delivery systems function correctly before launching to the public.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies with low transaction fees, ensuring your store is adaptable to various customer preferences.
Accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees.
